content.title: UNF Q4 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Persist Despite Top-Line Growth and Strategic Investments
content.summary: Workplace uniform provider UniFirst (NYSE:UNF) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 2.7% year on year to $621.3 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $2.49 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $1.89 per share was 5.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
